import sys, time, json, random, resource
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import exact

def rss(): return resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024.0
rng = random.Random(11)
N = 512; T = 384; S = 512; O = 97; Q = 128; K = 4
from math import gcd
P = (Q * S) // gcd(T, Q * S)
prof = {'groups': K, 'jitter_ps': [1, 2, 3, 4],
        'measurements': [[0, 1, -3, 5], [1, 2, -2, 4], [2, 3, -1, 3], [3, 0, -4, 2]]}
groups = {}
for n_ in range(N):
    for s_ in range(9):
        groups[(n_, s_)] = rng.randrange(K)
link_index = {}
links = []
slices = [[] for _ in range(Q)]
for q in range(Q):
    lst = []
    for r in range(4):
        mi = (q + r) % 9
        mask = 1 << mi; slot = mi
        for i in range(N):
            j = i ^ mask
            if j < i: continue
            key = (i, j, slot)
            li = link_index.get(key)
            if li is None:
                li = len(links); link_index[key] = li
                links.append({'ends': [[i, slot, groups[(i, slot)]],
                                       [j, slot, groups[(j, slot)]]],
                              'delay_ns': [rng.randint(1, 300), rng.randint(1, 300)],
                              'defer_rounds': [rng.randint(0, 3), rng.randint(0, 3)]})
            lst.append(li)
    slices[q] = lst
fab = {'n': N, 'interval_ns': T, 'slice_ns': S, 'offset_ns': O,
       'drift_ppb': [rng.randint(0, 1000) for _ in range(N)],
       'heat': [[rng.randrange(N), rng.randrange(P), 0, 0] for _ in range(0)],
       'anchors': [[0, 0, P]], 'links': links, 'slices': slices,
       'blackouts': [], 'guards_ns': [0, 5, 10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 95],
       'reconfig_ns': 0}
t0 = time.time()
plan = exact.compile_plan(prof, fab)
print('request1 plan %.2fs rss=%.0f' % (time.time() - t0, rss()))
t0 = time.time()
res = exact.audit(prof, fab, plan)
print('request2 audit %.2fs -> %s rss=%.0f' % (time.time() - t0, res, rss()))
s = json.dumps(plan, separators=(',', ':'))
print('json MB %.1f total %.2fs rss=%.0f' % (len(s)/1e6, time.time()-t0, rss()))
PYEOF
cd /tmp/t && timeout 900 python3 stress3.py
